info.name: # Project #1 - SOAP ISBN Checker
info.description:
## SOAP ISBN Checker

This collection interacts with the public daehosting.com ISBN SOAP web service to validate ISBN (International Standard Book Number) values. It is organized as a set of test cases that exercise both valid and invalid inputs.

### Purpose
It demonstrates how to build and send SOAP XML requests from Postman to an ISBN validation service and verify the responses. Given an ISBN, the service checks the number's checksum and returns whether it is valid.

### Service Details
- Endpoint: https://webservices.daehosting.com/services/isbnservice.wso
- Protocol: SOAP over HTTP POST
- Header: Content-Type: text/xml; charset=utf-8

### Requests / Test Cases
- TC #1 Positive - valid: sends a well-formed, valid ISBN and expects a true validation result.
- TC #2 Negative - Invalid: sends an invalid ISBN and expects a false validation result.

### How to Use
1. Send the request with a raw XML SOAP body containing the ISBN in the sISBN element.
2. Inspect the XML response - the validation result element returns true or false.
3. Use the positive and negative test cases to confirm the service behaves correctly for both valid and invalid ISBNs.

### Notes
- Requests and responses use raw XML to conform to the SOAP protocol.
- Response parsing may be needed to extract the boolean validation result.

response.name: TC #34 Negative - GET Method
response.body:
DataFlex Web Service for testing ISBN Numbers

DataFlex Web Service to validate ISBN numbers.

The following operations are available. For a formal definition, please review the Service Description.
  • IsValidISBN13
    The test is done by calculation on the first 12 digits and compare the result with the checksum number at the end. You have to pass a 13 digits number.

  • IsValidISBN10
    The test is done by calculation on the first 9 digits and compare the result with the checksum number at the end. You have to pass a 10 digits number or 8 digits and an X.

request.description: Sends a PUT request to the SOAP endpoint. Expects a 405 Method Not Allowed.
Sends a DELETE request to the SOAP endpoint. Expects a 405 Method Not Allowed.
Sends a valid ISBN-10 value using the IsValidISBN10 operation. Expects a true result.
